tools.name: suggest_filters
tools.description: Suggest Joomil listing filters from a short free-text query about a category, place or budget. Returns filters, a category confidence score and warnings, not matching listings.

tools.name: search_classifieds
tools.description: Search public Joomil.ch classified ads by keyword, category, place or budget. Returns a paginated list with titles, short descriptions, prices in CHF, locations and listing URLs. With no filters, returns recent listings. No seller contact details or transactions.

tools.name: get_classified
tools.description: Get full details of a single classified ad on Joomil.ch by its numeric ID. Returns complete description, all images URLs, category breadcrumb (full_path), public seller info (name, certified status, pro company), expiry date and boost level.

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: List active categories of the Joomil.ch marketplace. Returns a flat list with parent_id for hierarchy reconstruction. Omit parent_id for all categories, use parent_id=0 for root categories only, or pass a specific ID to get direct children of that category.

tools.name: get_cantons
tools.description: List the Swiss cantons supported by Joomil's `canton` filter. Returns the exact `name` value accepted by search_classifieds, plus a readable French label (e.g. 'Bern' rather than 'Berne').

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "suggest_filters" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Infer search_classifieds filters from a natural-language query. Use this before search_classifieds when the user mentions a category, location, canton or price in free text. Returns a ready-to-use filters object, a category confidence score and warnings for uncertain matches." → after: "Suggest Joomil listing filters from a short free-text query about a category, place or budget. Returns filters, a category confidence score and warnings, not matching listings."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
